name: Ahmad Zaki
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the racetrack, but within the intricate world of logistics and supply chain management. After graduating with a degree in Industrial Engineering, he initially focused on optimizing operations for manufacturing plants. However, his passion for Formula 1 led him to seek opportunities within the sport. He started as a logistics coordinator for a smaller racing team, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for streamlining processes and improving efficiency. 

His meticulous approach and ability to see the bigger picture earned him a reputation for solving complex logistical challenges. Ahmad's focus on innovation and efficiency makes him invaluable to the team. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a collaborative environment, ensuring that every department works in harmony towards achieving race-winning performance. At Alpine F1, he aims to bring a fresh perspective and to create a more sustainable and efficient operation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with flowcharts and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers communicating via concise bullet points in emails.
